summary: Added a session-only Auto-approve commands toggle in Chat Settings, with confirmation and a visible Turn off control.
instructions: Open Chat → Settings → Auto-approve commands: Off after connecting a service. Confirm the warning to allow all new shell command requests to run without individual approval. This can delete files or change this computer; enable only when you trust the task. Resolve existing pending approvals manually before enabling. Send a harmless request such as “Run printf hello” and check the command, automatic approval notice and output in Chat and Tasks. Use Turn off in the visible warning or the Settings toggle to restore manual approval. Turning it off does not stop commands already approved or running. Auto-approve resets to Off on agent restart, service disconnect or service change; it is not stored in browser storage or persisted across sessions. The normal approval path, authenticated same-origin controls and supervisor recovery boundary are preserved. All 151 automated tests, JavaScript syntax validation and startup self-test passed. No live model or visual browser test was performed.
